dsDescriptionValue.value: A dataset containing all Dutch case law (1992-2021) from courts of appeal, Supreme Court and Advocate-Generals in the field of tort law referencing the potential macro consequences of a judicial decision. The dataset is based on the open data of the Dutch judiciary, from which all cases referencing the potential macro consequences of the decision were selected through a layered search strategy.

value: van Deursen, Stijn, 2024, "Rechtspraak open data 1905-2021", https://doi.org/10.34894/H4QURK
Open data from the Dutch judiciary (https://www.rechtspraak.nl/Uitspraken/paginas/open-data.aspx)
